[Intro]
[D#5]
Oh, wa, ah, ah, ah!
Oh, wa, ah, ah, ah!
Oh, oh.
Oh, oh.
Oh, oh.

[Verse 1]
[D#5]Drowning deep
in my
sea of loath-
ing.
Broken your
servant I
kneel.
Will you give in to me?
It seems what's
left of my
human side,
Is slowly
changing
in
me.
Will you give in to me?

[Pre-Chorus]
[D#5]Looking at
my own re-
flection, When
suddenly it
changes. Vi-
olently it
changes.
There
is no
turning back
now. You've
woken up the
demon
in
me.

[Chorus]
[D#5]Get up, come on get
down with the sickness.
Get up, come on get
down with the sickness.
Open up your hate,
and let it flow into me.
Get up, come on get
down with the sickness. You
mother get up come on get
down with the sickness. You
fucker get up come on get
down with the sickness.
Madness is the gift,
that has been given to me.

[Break]
[D#5]

[Verse 2]
[D#5]I can see in-
side you, the
sickness is
rising. Don't
try to de-
ny what you
feel.
Will you give in to me?
It seems that
all that was
good has died,
And is de-
caying
in
me.
Will you give in to me?

[Pre-Chorus]
[D#5]It seems you're
having some
trouble. In
dealing with these
changes. Liv-
ing with these
changes.
Now the
world is a
scary place,
Now that you've
woken up the
demon
in
me.

[Chorus]
[D#5]Get up, come on get
down with the sickness.
Get up, come on get
down with the sickness.
Get up, come on get
down with the sickness.
Open up your hate,
and let it flow into me.
Get up, come on get
down with the sickness. You
mother get up come on get
down with the sickness. You
fucker get up come on get
down with the sickness.
Madness is the gift,
that has been given to me.

[Interlude]
[D#5]

[Break]
Oh, wa, ah, ah, ah!

[Chorus]
[D#5]Get up, come on get
down with the sickness.
Get up, come on get
down with the sickness.
Get up, come on get
down with the sickness.
Open up your hate,
and let it flow into me.
Get up, come on get
down with the sickness. You
mother get up come on get
down with the sickness. You
fucker get up come on get
down with the sickness.
Madness has now come
over me.
title: Down with the Sickness
tuning: C# G# C# F# A# D#
